title: Epic Fail
text: Epic Fail. I've been baking bread for the better part of 50 years. Never tried a Pullman loaf until today.  I used the recipe from King Arthur flour. The bread was good, the pan was a failure. You have to grease the pan so that you can get the bread out. That oil leaked out of the corners of the pan when it got hot and burned all over the oven, while the bread oozed out the top under the lid. Large mess!
